mainEntity.name: What is the closest alternative to Freshdesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zendesk is the closest broad help desk comparison in this list. Zoho Desk is worth checking for price-sensitive teams, Help Scout for email-led support, and Gorgias for ecommerce. The right choice depends on channels, workflow depth and total cost.

mainEntity.name: Does Freshdesk have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freshdesk has a Free Program for up to two agents for six months. Freshworks says this program applies to Freshdesk, not Freshdesk Omni. Check the official help article for current eligibility and limits.
Neither is better for every team. The entry annual prices match on the official annual-billing pages checked October 28, 2026, but plan features, AI usage, channels and migration requirements differ.

mainEntity.name: Can I export tickets from Freshdesk before switching?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freshdesk documents ticket exports to CSV or Excel for admins and supervisors. Its support article says a ticket-list export does not include the full conversation or archived ticket history; account export is needed for broader data.

mainEntity.name: What should I check before moving away from Freshdesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inventory tickets, full conversations, archived records, contacts, companies, attachments, knowledge articles, fields, automations, SLAs, reports and integrations. Export a sample and test the destination import before cancelling.
